method.sample_rate: Every authored integer frame at30fps, all4clips.
method.actual_surface: Evaluated deformed mesh vertices and every garment triangle centroid from both sleeves.
method.torso_volume: Largest connected base-cloth Chest component. Explicit boundary-loop triangle fans close only renderer-seam holes in an audit copy; each fan center follows its boundary mean. Every audit volume edge has exactly2incident triangles. Original surface and synthetic cap triangles are classified separately.
method.equipment_volume: Each closed connected non-cloth Chest component separately; open decorative surfaces recorded but not assigned an inside volume.
method.anatomical_zones: Rest-space closest shoulder/elbow/wrist centerline. Proximal shoulder is0–35%of upperarm length. Middle35–70%,distal70–100%,forearm separate. Shoulder attachment may touch; no zone silently excluded.
method.inside_test: Majority odd/even ray parity along three oblique directions, after component axis-aligned bounds; nearest actual triangle gives penetration depth.
limitations: Vertex and centroid samples can miss very small edge-only triangle intersections.
Near artificial shoulder caps, signed distances diagnose envelope intrusion, not a physical cloth solver.
Integer samples do not prove inter-frame blends, game poses,collisions or Unity behavior.
Numerical clearance is not standalone visual or AAA quality approval.
